bagPolicy.summary: At Utah Athletics events, one clear bag up to 12" x 12" x 6" (or a 1 gallon plastic bag) plus a small clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5" is allowed.
allowed: One clear bag up to 12" x 12" x 6"
One 1 gallon clear plastic storage bag
prohibited: Non clear bags larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
Seat cushions with pockets, zippers or compartments
bagPolicy.note: The posted policy names Utah Athletics events; confirm on your concert's event page. Diaper bags and medically necessary bags are allowed after inspection.
